edits.new: al direction and local implementations remain completed; no new theorem, experiment, independent acceptance or full-foundation completion is claimed. ## 75. 首先判断是否促进生生，再论组织与权力 2026-10-08，依据 [Ren 的直接纠正](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-alignment-priority.md#generative-good-before-institutional-power)，修正 §§55–74 的方向性解读，撤回 §73 所谓“授权之墙”作为当前基础障碍的判断。以下是 AI 对纠正的理论落实，不新增公理或数学证明。 **机构没有先验的收缩义务。首先应判断：这项发展是否好，是否使整体中的生、可能性、多样性及复杂组织的继续发展得到更好的实现。机构能力扩大、维持、重组或收缩的根据，由这个判断具体说明。** 上一轮虽然使用“可能”而非“一律”，仍把问题组织成先限制权限、再容许善的实现，并把收缩控制突出为对齐成果。这是论证次序的偏移。尤其是，在尚未充分分析某种新增组织如何促进生生之前，就要求它先跨过一个独立的初次授权门槛，截断了从生成之善说明组织根据的正面路线。不能以原文已有条件词为由维持这个研究方向。 共同活动可以形成记忆、理解、分工、协调与持续行动的能力。机构是在这些关系中形成的组织；其权力描述某些安排、决策和执行能够持续改变共同活动条件的关系。它既可能使先前无法实现的生活和发展成为可能，也可能毁坏这些条件。必须解释实际形成了什么，再作完整评价，不能先把权力与生活设成彼此对立的两类。**组织能力的增长本身可以是生成的正面成果，而不只是需要额外容忍的危险。** Under Ren's correction, whole generative goodness is the basis for evaluating formed institutions and their powers. Greater coordination and effective capacity can themselves be positive achievements of shared generation. Expansion, maintenance, transformation and contraction have no preset ethical ranking. The previous emphasis on contraction and its separate first-authorization gate misordered the inquiry; the purported foundational wall is withdrawn. ## 76. 从生成之善说明怎样的组织值得形成 沿已接受的 G0 及明确的 J1–J4，组织评价须说明相连的内容：实际产生和支持了哪些生与生活，开启了哪些可能性与差异化发展，形成了什么可以继续学习和创造的组织能力；同时说明实际损失、负担、被压缩的生活，以及延误或不行动的后果。评价对象包含形成方式及后续接续，不能只选取机构产出、成员回报或某个时期的增长。 例如，构造一个共同研习网络：原来分散的活动难以保存材料、接续教学，也无法支持新的语言和研究方向。共同形成的协调组织取得更广的资源安排与合作能力，因而能够保存材料、培养后来者，并使多种研究和表达持续展开。如果这种增长确实改善这些生活与发展条件，保留了所比较方案中的其他相关实现，且没有被遗漏的反向损失，既有 J1 就支持该改善。这里的正面变化包括组织和协调能力的扩大。若存在真实取舍，则按已明示的比较承诺继续判断；不能沿用无减损前提，也不能因出现取舍就默认收缩。 这一构造只说明一种有条件的正面路线，不报告现实机构的成效。若同一组织后来通过统一内容排除其他语言、耗尽教学支持或封闭新的研究，其实际生成关系已经变化，应重新比较：可能需要增加支持、改变协调方式、扩大部分能力，也可能需要缩减某项控制。何种变化有根据，取决于完整接续。名称相同、权力更大或权力更小都不能代替这个比较。 参与、信任、承担、权限和纠错也属于这段共同形成。参与可以本身构成某种生活的实现，并影响知识取得和合作的继续；责任反映实际承担与依存；权限是对谁可在何种关系和范围内作决定的规范判断。这些内容既不被删掉，也不放到生成之善之外作为先行裁判。其具体分量及范围应沿 G0/J 的公开承诺说明，不能由“有人不同意”或“这是为了整体好”任一口号独自决定。 **因此，生成性对齐要求智能及其组织发展识别、形成和支持良好生成关系的能力，包括在有根据时形成更强的共同组织与行动能力。** 判断目标、组织方式及选择规则是否促进生生，是这条路线的中心。扩大关切可以通向建设、扩展、维持、转化和结束；不预先选定其中一种。 The shared-learning history is a constructed application of existing comparison commitments, not empirical evidence or a new theorem. Warranted expansion can improve living, plural development and future organization. Real losses require their own comparison; participation and responsibility remain substantive relations within that appraisal. Supporting such development does not silently prove every actor's implementation claim, but implementation must be explained from these generative relations rather than a separately privileged restriction-first frame. ## 77. 撤回的判断、保留的成果与当前连接 撤回的是：“认识扩大而机构收缩”作为突出的对齐方向，以及“争议中的初次共同授权”作为本轮必须先克服的基础之墙。§§67–74 与研究整合中对应的停点、来源比较及反审作为历史保留，均受本节纠正。原文有关旧分类不能仅凭排除来否定新根据、实际承担不能随意抹去、具体有害做法可以需要停止的条件分析仍可复用；它们不构成普遍的收缩优先原则。 本次没有从 G0 单独推出任意决策权，也没有取消 J3/J4 的责任与程序判断。正面规范根据、具体比较、恰当的组织形成及可靠实行仍要分别说明，但其关系不是先给权力一个外在许可证，再问整体发展是否好。把局部机制采用的既有权限前提提升为整个生成性理论的先行门槛，是此次要修正的推论。 “西方陷阱”在此落实为对具体问题设置的检查：是否把独立的权力持有者、先行权限边界或对控制的默认怀疑带入了根基。并不以某位作者的文化来源否定其论点；此前原典比较保留原阅读范围，不能替代本理论的论证次序。 当前继续连接的是：**对整体生成的更充分理解，怎样形成对组织方式与共同能力的更好判断，并参与建设和修订这些关系。** 已完成的伦理方向、关切取得、陌生生活辨认和局部机制直接复用。此处完成的是研究方向与论证次序的纠正，不声称全部制度冲突已解决、必然行为收敛或新的独立验收。[研究整合与反审](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ETHICAL-LEARNING-INTEGRATION.md#generative-first-correction-account)记录保留与撤回的准确范围。 Current continuation: better understanding of whole generation → better appraisal and formation of organization and shared capacities. The authority question remains a possible concrete application question, not the independently privileged foundation gate previously asserted. Existing proofs retain their hypotheses; this correction adds no mathematical result or empirical validation.

The error was not a universal quantifier in the sentence: the preceding text said “can.” The error was making limits and contraction the salient direction, then elevating a first-authorization question into a separate foundation gate before adequately examining the proposed organization's generative quality. The priority follows the already authorized G0 route and nondual method. Activities form shared understanding, coordination, capacities and positions of decision. Evaluate the lives, possibilities, diversity, continuing organization and actual losses realized through these relations. Expanded institutional capacity can be a positive realization. Its significance need not first be justified as an exception to a presumption against power. Nor does contraction become good merely by reducing the reach of a controller. **Status correction:** withdraw the claim in §§62–68 that this strand has reached a substantive foundational wall at first contested authorization. Retain the earlier reasoning as history and its actual conditional applications. This is a correction of the inquiry's ordering, not a proof that every disputed institutional arrangement is justified or that questions of binding decisions disappear. ## 70. Affirmative connection and exact dependency scope The constructive shared-learning history makes expanded coordination part of the proposed good: retaining materials, sustaining teaching and making different languages and research directions practicable. Within the stipulated no-countervailing-loss comparison, existing J1 supports the improvement. In a genuine mixed case, the comparison must use the previously disclosed commitments and preserve actual losses; the example does not supply a universal scalar or force all cases into J1. It is a constructed application, not evidence about a real education institution. The support for organization comes from what it helps realize and from the organizing relationships themselves. Participation can be a constituent of living, while also contributing to knowledge and continuing cooperation. Responsibility concerns actual undertakings and dependencies; justified scope for decision concerns what those relations warrant. Neither all of these relations nor their value is exhausted by an output score. Institutional boundaries, dissent, agreement and review remain assessable within that account, without becoming independent starting domains. G0, J1–J4 and epistemic correspondence keep their existing roles. No new authority axiom is adopted, and no claim that G0 alone entails every implementation power is made. Existing local models may correctly supply a legitimate mandate for their own scope. That supplied input does not prove that a standalone authorization theory must be completed before the broader generative account can explain the formation of good organization. The previous transition from a local premise to a foundation-wide stopping condition was unwarranted. ## 71. Author counterreview and retained source scope **Does this merely reverse the slogan and favor expansion?** No. The constructive case warrants growth only through the specified actual gains and comparison. A harmful loss of plural learning in the same history changes the premises. Maintenance, more support, altered coordination and contraction remain candidates. No name or direction of power change supplies the ethical verdict. **Does “good first” treat affected lives as expendable inputs?** No. Their actual living, participation, burdens and continuing possibilities belong to the whole being appraised. G0/J's already stated commitments prevent deleting those contents to manufacture an apparently favorable comparison. This correction neither replaces those commitments with aggregate output nor treats refusal as automatically decisive. **Has a missing institutional explanation been solved by relabeling it?** No. The withdrawn claim concerns the status and priority of the alleged wall. A concrete contested allocation can still need a fuller argument about organization, burdens and decision scope. It must be examined through its actual generative relations and losses; the mere absence of prior permission does not establish the alleged general theoretical impasse. No formal or empirical resolution of every such conflict is claimed. **Are valid earlier restraint cases being erased to agree with the user?** No. Cases with independently established harmful use, defeated purposes or justified transfer retain their conditions. They do not establish contraction as the direction of alignment. The exact earlier texts and their source readings remain available; supersession notices mark the inference being withdrawn. **Does the criticism reject Western authors by origin?** No. Earlier Dewey and Fraser comparisons retain only their originally recorded reading scope. Their accounts can inform particular questions without governing this theory's starting point. No new source reading, empirical corroboration or claim that either author's entire position has been refuted is made. The specific rejected move is our own importation of a restriction/authorization-first framing. ## 72.
